items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the highway law, in relation to designating a portion of the state highway system in the town of Sherman as the "Alfred F. Jones Memorial Bridge"
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S5060

TITLE OF BILL:
An act to amend the highway law, in relation to designating a portion of
the state highway system in the town of Sherman as the "Alfred F. Jones
Memorial Bridge"

PURPOSE: To designate the bridge on State Route 76
crossing Interstate Route 86 in the Town of Sherman, County of
Chautauqua, as the "Alfred F. Jones Memorial Bridge".

SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:; Section 1. Adds a new
subdivision (kk) to Section 242 of the highway law designating the
bridge on State Route seventy-six, also known as Osborne Street, which
crosses over Interstate Route eighty-six, in the Town of Sherman, County
of Chautauqua, as the "Alfred F. Jones Memorial Bridge."

Section 2. Provides that the Commissioner of the Department of
Transportation shall provide for the installation and maintenance of
adequate signage reflecting the ceremonial designation of this bridge as
the "Alfred F. Jones Memorial Bridge."

JUSTIFICATION: Alfred F. Jones was an individual who
exemplified community service. He served in the military as a World War
II Tank Commander in the 751st Tank Battalion. After serving his
country, Mr. Jones returned to Mayville where he devoted most of his
adult life to the promotion and development of Western New York.

His crowning achievement was the completion of Interstate Route 86.
Starting in 1990, then Chautauqua County Legislator Alfred F. Jones and
his colleagues began an advocacy campaign for the completion of what
they referred to as the "Missing link," a 20 mile stretch of I-86 that
remained a two lane highway. These efforts would unite people and
political forces from all over Western New York behind the singular goal
of finishing the four lane expressway that would provide valuable
economic stimulus to the region.

This bill would memorialize the Route 76 bridge which passes over
Interstate 86 as the "Alfred F. Jones Memorial bridge". Because the
memorial signs will be visible to motorists on Interstate 86 it will
serve to honor his perseverance and dedication to the completion of I-86
as well as his contributions to Chautauqua County during his many years
of public service.

LEGISLATIVE HISTORY: This is a new bill.

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:; None.

EFFECTIVE DATE: This act shall take effect immediately.
